name: HZ4 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant galaxy HZ4, seen by Hubble.
label: hz4-hubble
story: Somewhere in this deep frame is HZ4, an ordinary star-forming galaxy seen a billion years after the Big Bang, one of the few in its sample whose dust glow ALMA detected. Hubble mapped its starlight to compare with ALMA's view of its gas and dust.

claims.text: HZ4 is a galaxy in a sample of normal galaxies at 5<z<6 targeted by Hubble program 13641
HZ4 lies in the COSMOS field
These galaxies are seen a billion years after the Big Bang
Hubble mapped the galaxies' starlight to compare with ALMA measurements of their gas and dust
HZ4 is one of the few galaxies in the sample detected in dust continuum
